programs.feeNote: Includes tuition and other academic/non-academic expenses (hostel, health insurance etc.); excludes refundable caution deposit Rs 50000 and mess bills (actuals).

programs.salaryNote: NIRF 2026 data submitted by IIM Jammu: median for graduates of academic year 2024-25 (all 2-year PG programmes). The MBA 2024-26 placement report linked from iimj.ac.in (hosted on Google Drive) states a median CTC of INR 15.00 LPA.
